arxiv-2011-12822.title: Square-free reducts of words Thanks: Research supported by the National Science Center of Poland, grant 2015/17/B/ST1/02660.
arxiv-2011-12822.creator: Jarosław Grytczuk, Szymon Stankiewicz
arxiv-2011-12822.description: Abstract . A square is a finite non-empty word consisting of two identical adjacent blocks. A word is square-free if it does not contain a square as a factor. In any finite word one may delete the repeated block of a square, obtaining thereby a shorter word.

arxiv-2404-06573.creator: Samuel Castelo Mourelle, Enrique Macías-Virgós, David Mosquera-Lois
arxiv-2404-06573.description: Abstract . We introduce two novel complementary notions of the Lefschetz number for a functor from a finite acyclic category to itself and we prove a Lefschetz fixed-object theorem and a Lefschetz fixed-morphism theorem. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary: 55M20 Secondary: 55U10 Introduction Let X be a finite simplicial structure, possibly more general than a simplicial complex.

arxiv-2410-13385.title: On the Use of Audio to Improve Dialogue Policies
arxiv-2410-13385.creator: Daniel Roncel Díaz, Federico Costa, Javier Hernando
arxiv-2410-13385.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Daniel Roncel Díaz, Federico Costa, Javier Hernando. With the significant progress of speech technologies, spoken goal-oriented dialogue systems are becoming increasingly popular. One of the main modules of a dialogue system is typically the dialogue policy, which is responsible for determining system actions. This component usually relies only on audio transcriptions, being strongly dependent on their quality and ignoring very important extralinguistic information embedded in the user’s speech.

pmc-11284932.creator: Lifang Liu, Shanshan Peng, Yuhao Wei, Wenao Yu, Jiaqiang Liao, Wen Du, Ying Shi, Qiurong He, Dongsheng Wu, Li Chen, Su Han, Ling Zhang, Jiang Shen, Xia Jiang, Jiayuan Li, Lijun Peng, Ben Zhang, Yuqin Yao, Qin Zhang
pmc-11284932.description: AbstractBackgroundPneumoconiosis mostly combines pulmonary and cardiovascular diseases, among which pulmonary heart disease (PHD) is of major concern due to its significant impact on the survival of pneumoconiosis patients. White cell count (WCC), red cell distribution width (RDW) and platelet parameters are thought to affect inflammatory responses and may be predictors of various cardiovascular diseases.

pmc-11575010.title: Nonsurgical endodontic retreatment of C-shaped maxillary molars: case reports and review of literature
pmc-11575010.creator: Ming Liu, Yanling Huang, Yixuan Wu, Yi Zhang, Zhisheng Zhang, Qianju Wu
pmc-11575010.description: The root canal systems of maxillary first molar (MFM) and maxillary second molar (MSM) variations represent a clinical challenge for endodontists, especially the prevalence of fused C-shaped roots. Having a thorough knowledge of root canal configuration is an extremely important point for a successful root canal treatment to avoid missing extra canals.

pmc-11665353.title: Inflammatory factor Interleukin-6 and its correlation with rheumatoid arthritis: A meta-analysis
pmc-11665353.creator: Xiaojuan Hao, Huani Zhao, Linhui Zhu, Zhiteng Li, Jing Yang, Qian Bai
pmc-11665353.description: Introductionat present, there are inconsistent research findings regarding the precise relationship between IL-6 gene polymorphisms (GPMs) and rheumatoid arthritis (RA). This work employed meta-analysis (MA) methodology to systematically evaluate the correlation between IL-6 GPMs and susceptibility to RA.Material and methodsthis study comprehensively searched multiple databases from inception to March 31, 2024.

pmc-11716103.title: Senescence‐associated secretory phenotype (SASP) index in individuals across the Alzheimer’s disease continuum
pmc-11716103.creator: Alvaro de Oliveira Franco, Thomas Hugentobler Schlickmann, João Pedro Ferrari‐Souza, Marco Antônio de Bastiani, Raphael Machado Castilhos, Eduardo R Zimmer
pmc-11716103.description: BackgroundCellular senescence (CS) is a hallmark of aging. Senescence‐associated secretory phenotype (SASP) index was recently developed based on the levels of blood SASP‐related proteins. Although aging is a primary risk factor for Alzheimer's disease (AD), the role of CS in this neurodegenerative condition is not well understood.

pmc-12422124.title: Case Series and Literature Review on Phenotypic Variants of Restless Legs Syndrome (RLS): A Unique Phase of Typical RLS?
pmc-12422124.creator: Xinyan Zhang, Xue Zhou, Yangyang Shen, Jiafeng Ren, Weifang Yin, Hongxin Mi, Junying Zhou
pmc-12422124.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). PurposeThe variants of restless legs syndrome (RLS) remain poorly recognized, complicating differential diagnosis and treatment in clinical practice. We aimed to explore the clinical features and potential diagnostic indicators of variant RLS through clinical cases and literature review.Patients and MethodsPatients with variants of RLS were collected from the sleep medicine center of West China Hospital and followed up till February 2024. Demographic and clinical information were collected, and questionnaires were used to assess RLS symptom severity, sleep disturbances, and daytime dysfunction.

pmc-12765025.title: Genome-wide variation reveal that goats were introduced into Asia via multiple migrations
pmc-12765025.creator: Takahiro Yonezawa, Jiaqi Wu, Ryo Masuko, Kenta Iso, Yuto Nomura, Risa Tabata, Maho Masaoka, Ayin, Fuki Kawaguchi, Shinji Sasazaki, Aisaku Arakawa, Koh Nomura, Yukimizu Takahashi, Eiji Kobayashi, Manoj Kumar Shah, Muhammad Omar Faruque, Joseph S. Masangkay, Meirat Bakhtin, Polat Kazymbet, Tashi Dorji
pmc-12765025.description: In recent world-wide studies on the autosomal genetic diversity of goats, Asian goats were represented only by Southwest Asian, Pakistani and Chinese breeds. We have collected 55 K genome-wide SNP genotypes for 12 South/Southeast Asian and 2 central Asian goat populations, and inferred the origin and evolutionary history of Asian goats based on the population genomic analyses.

pmc-13181976.title: Translation, cultural adaptation, and psychometric validation of the Chinese versions of the PROMIS + HF-27 and PROMIS + HF-10 profiles in patients with heart failure
pmc-13181976.creator: Wanhui Li, Zhiyi Pei, Wenpei Liu, Chen Zhang, Jiayi Lin, Meihua Piao, Xiaofeng Kang, Yin Zhou, Yingying Guo, Xiaoxuan Zhou, Dingyang Gao, Xiaoyin Yang, Yingying Hu, Hui Ma, Minhong Yu
pmc-13181976.description: BackgroundHeart failure (HF) is a prevalent clinical syndrome characterized by dyspnea, fatigue, exercise intolerance, and oedema, significantly impairing patients’ health-related quality of life (HRQoL). The PROMIS + HF profile is a targeted instrument designed to evaluate novel interventions, enhance clinical care and shared decision-making, and assess quality of care. However, a linguistically validated Chinese version is currently lacking.

pmc-13342580.title: SSD-DIS: A Semi-Synthetic Shadow Dataset for Document Images
pmc-13342580.creator: Bingshu Wang, Jia Li, Ze Wang, Aihong Shangguan
pmc-13342580.description: With rising demand for remote work and education, smartphones and other portable photographic devices are increasingly used to capture physical documents, which are then shared as electronic files. However, shadows in such images hinder reading. Currently available shadow removal datasets exhibit certain limitations. This paper creates a semi-synthetic dataset (SSD-DIS) with 12,224 image sets.
